production_baseline.construction: Server Agent 1.3.4-p1 runtime plus the official 1.4.0 overlay (agent.php, lib/ArtifactManager.php, lib/ReleaseValidator.php) — see 1.4.0-lineage.json. lib/PipelineExecutor.php was deliberately preserved unchanged by that overlay, so Production's active runtime still carries the pre-Deployment-#183/#184-fix implementation.

notes: This is the ONE exceptional bootstrap release for the Server Agent: 1.4.0 has no way to understand the new exact-commit self-upgrade control contract (server_agent_control_jobs / ServerAgentPackage), so it must be installed once via agent/install/upgrade-1.4.1.sh, the same manual-overlay pattern 1.4.0 itself used.

lib/PipelineExecutor.php is a CANDIDATE file in this release, not preserved — it carries the Deployment #183/#184 correctness fix (commit bcc7670f): unique prepare/before_activation/activation sequences, trailing-|| true stripping, and fail-closed activation.

lib/SelfUpgradeManager.php is new in this release and adds the exact-commit self-upgrade runtime support that every SUBSEQUENT Server Agent release is expected to use instead of a hand-run overlay script.
agent/install/deployment-server-agent-restart (+ .sudoers) is a new, narrowly-scoped privileged helper this release also installs — restart-only, zero arguments, never a general-purpose command.

rollback.source: the run_id-scoped, SHA-256-verified backup captured from the active server before activation
